_doc: The title's attract mode (src/client/attract.ts): after idleSeconds without input on the title menu, demos play one after another with the HUD on and the banner over them; any key, click or pad button goes back to the menu. Each run is a scenario (scenarios/<scenario>.skate) played in the page and shown from tick from to tick to (120 a second); label says where it is. A park scenario (park soma) also plays in the city world, where the park is; runs in another world than the one loaded are skipped.
